scientific_integrity: The statement is an exact self-contained mathematical theorem; independent validation has not been performed. Numerical checks support, rather than replace, the general Gauss-sum proof.
scientific_limitations: Restricted to ordered unweighted mixed sums over finite fields of characteristic at least five. No optimal weighted bilinear extension bound, positional target enumeration, or independent originality certification is claimed.
title: The complete mixed parabola–quartic convolution spectrum over odd finite fields
